task: Fluid Speech Pro (FluidVoice-Labs/fluid-speech-pro-coreml, released 2026-11-13) against Fluid Speech Mini
hardware: Apple M5 Max Mac Studio, macOS 27
configuration: fluidbench release build, FluidInference/FluidAudio main @16780f04, whole-utterance greedy decode, Word Boost = CTC 110M rescoring with the manifest's 36 bias terms (no WordBoostGuard, no ExpressNumberFormatter). Pro loaded as .ultra from a folder linking JointDecision.mlmodelc as JointDecisionv3.mlmodelc (same joint inputs and outputs as Mini).
notes: Bench rows skip ExpressNumberFormatter, which the app runs on Express output. Pro writes digits, currency and times itself, so most of its real-voice gain (the number group) is something the app already gets for Mini.
Without the number group the real-voice set is 64 vs 63 errors in 678 words (Mini 9.44%, Pro 9.29%).
Pro is 25-language with automatic language detection; Mini is English only.

production_path_real_voice_50.configuration: ASREvalRunnerTests through TranscriptionService (Debug, live path), ORTTAAI_ASR_EVAL_BIAS=1: Word Boost with WordBoostGuard, ExpressNumberFormatter, the app's pinned FluidAudio c79c410. Both models installed by ExpressModelStore (checksums verified).
production_path_real_voice_50.note: In the app the two tie on English real voice (59 errors each); Pro's case is its 24 other languages.
